card.name: Small words before dressings and occlusion
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, with, under, of, tight) right before a covering or support item such as a dressing, occlusion or crutches. Seen in wound care and topical-steroid text.

modes.label: Before a dressing
modes.description: Article or preposition just ahead of the word dressing in wound-covering instructions.
modes.example: Close the skin incision with 2 layers of absorbable sutures and apply<< a>> standard dressing, such as wound closure strips

modes.label: Under occlusion
modes.description: The word under before occlusion in topical corticosteroid risk lists.
modes.example: use over a large surface area or to areas<< under>> occlusion, prolonged use, altered skin

modes.label: Mobility aids
modes.description: Linking word or comma in a list of aids such as crutches, braces and wheelchairs.
modes.example: often require the aid<< of>> crutches, braces, or wheelchairs
